title: Quota & Usage Interface

raw_value.description: Usage is reported as an unformatted raw value, never a pre-formatted display string.
raw_value.claim_boundary: No live provider usage reading is fetched locally. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

unit.description: Every value carries an explicit unit from a closed enum; unknown units are named rather than guessed.
unit.claim_boundary: No provider-specific unit table is claimed. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

period.description: Every value declares its reporting period so values from different windows are never compared blindly.
period.claim_boundary: No provider billing-cycle alignment is verified locally. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

measured_at.description: Values carry a UTC measurement instant, or null when the provider did not report one.
measured_at.claim_boundary: No clock synchronization with the provider is claimed. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

freshness.description: Freshness is derived deterministically from measurement age; future timestamps are not trusted.
freshness.claim_boundary: Freshness windows are local policy constants, not provider guarantees. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

source.description: Every value names its source so cached and estimated data is never mistaken for a live reading.
source.claim_boundary: No provider endpoint is contacted to confirm the source. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

is_estimate.description: Estimated values are flagged and are never treated as exact.
is_estimate.claim_boundary: No provider-side estimate accuracy is claimed. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

availability.description: Unavailable, not-reported, and unsupported states are explicit and carry no raw value.
availability.claim_boundary: Availability reflects caller-supplied local signals only. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

claim_boundary: This is a local quota and usage interface contract, not a live usage meter.
No plaintext credential or provider account identifier is stored or returned.
Live quota polling, provider billing reconciliation, and estimate accuracy remain deferred. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.
